title: Calm diagram: two to four steps
description: Full frame on a calm paper ground (no shapes, no gradient): an optional title, then two to four boxes in a row (upright: in a column), each with a label in the body font (64 px) and an optional value in the display font in the accent (150 px), joined by ink arrows that draw like a pen. Everything is built within about a second and the cut lands on a frame that already moves; the highlighted box fills with the accent at the cue 'land'. No icons, no decoration: the boxes and the words carry it.

cues.land: the highlighted box is filled here

notes: nodes: 2 to 4 (more are dropped), each a text or {"label", "value"}. highlight: index of the box that matters (-1 for none). step: seconds between boxes (the whole build stays within about a second). Use it with "transparent": false (full frame).
